brand_presence: Logo top left on slide 1 and top right of the last slide in large form with services line and URL; URL on slide 1 and the end card; no logo on slides 2-6
caption_summary: Short: repeats the title with a sleep emoji, two questions about night wakings and slow settling, one line promising small changes with big impact; no hashtags, no keyword
what_makes_it_work: A plain numbered list with an age-based wake window table that parents can screenshot. Little evidence it worked as a conversion piece: 22 likes and 4 comments, one of her lowest, and it uses stock-looking renders rather than a person or a story.
lumebook_takeaway: A useful age-by-age reference table on one slide is a save-worthy asset, but an early generic look like this earned little engagement, so pair it with a face or a character.
